did_you_know.text: Did you know? The prophet Elisha sent one of the prophets’ disciples to Ramoth-gilead to anoint Jehu as king.
Did you know? The prophet was instructed to anoint Jehu in an inner room, open the door, and flee immediately without delay.
Did you know? After anointing Jehu, the prophet proclaimed in the name of the LORD: “I have anointed you king over the people of the LORD, over Israel.”
Did you know? The prophecy given to Jehu said that dogs would eat Jezebel in the plot of land at Jezreel and that she would have no grave.
Did you know? When the army commanders heard that Jehu had been anointed king, they placed their garments beneath him, blew the trumpet, and proclaimed: “Jehu is king!”
Did you know? The watchman on the tower recognized the approaching mass of chariots and noted that Jehu drove rapidly and in a distinctive manner.
Did you know? Jehu shot Jehoram, king of Israel, with an arrow; it struck him between the shoulders and came out at his heart.
Did you know? Jehu ordered Jehoram’s body to be thrown onto Naboth’s plot of land because he saw this as the fulfillment of the LORD’s word concerning the blood of Naboth and his sons.
Did you know? Before Jehu arrived, Jezebel applied makeup to her eyes, arranged her hair, and looked out of the window.
Did you know? When they came to bury Jezebel, they found only her skull, feet, and the palms of her hands; thus the word of the LORD spoken through Elijah was fulfilled.
